extra.message: Mass assignment / privilege escalation: the registration endpoint trusts the client-supplied 'admin' field from the request body. When 'admin' is present in request_data (line 60), its value is passed directly to the User constructor (lines 65-66), so any unauthenticated user can register with admin=true and gain access to admin-only operations such as DELETE /users/v1/{username}. The 'admin' property is also not part of register_user_schema, showing it was never meant to be client-settable.
